categories.main_business_segments: Hubei Forbon Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two business segments: agrochemical additives and specialty fertilizers, and modern agriculture. The agrochemical additives and specialty fertilizers segment focuses on research, production, and sales of fertilizer additives and specialty fertilizers, serving global fertilizer companies. The modern agriculture segment includes biological agriculture, digital agriculture, microbial agents, biofertilizers, biopesticides, nematode control, bio-fermentation, food additives, and digital agricultural services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as CRISPR-Cas gene editing, homologous recombination, synthetic biology, and metabolic engineering in its biological agriculture segment. It employs proprietary manufacturing processes for fertilizer additives including powder and paste anti-caking agents, granulation improvers, multi-functional coating agents, and flotation agents for phosphate ores. Digital agriculture leverages soil CT scanning, AI-driven sensors, and intelligent irrigation systems. The company also develops environmentally friendly, biodegradable materials and precision agriculture solutions integrating water, fertilizer, and pesticide coupling with digital technology.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include over 400 large and medium-sized fertilizer manufacturers globally, such as YARA, ICL, EuroChem, OCP, and major Chinese fertilizer enterprises like Yuntianhua and Guizhou Phosphate. The company serves agricultural cooperatives, large-scale planting enterprises, and distributors in sectors including fertilizer production, mining, agriculture, and food industries. Its products and services target markets in China, Europe, Africa, Southeast Asia, and the Commonwealth of Independent States.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China and has established significant business centers in Europe, Africa, and China. It has subsidiaries and operations in the Netherlands, France, Canada, Morocco, Belarus, Hong Kong, and other regions. Its global footprint includes East Asia, Southeast Asia, Europe, North Africa, and the CIS region, with a strong presence in emerging markets and developed countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hubei Forbon Technology operates primarily upstream and midstream in the fertilizer supply chain, focusing on the production of fertilizer additives, specialty fertilizers, and biological agricultural products. It also provides integrated technical services and digital agriculture solutions, positioning itself as a technology and service provider that supports fertilizer manufacturers and large-scale agricultural producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in green, efficient, and nutrient-enriched agrochemical additives and specialty fertilizers. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on gene editing, microbial technology, bio-fermentation, and digital agriculture. Strategic priorities include developing environmentally friendly products, precision agriculture technologies, and integrated 'water-fertilizer-pesticide coupling + digital technology' solutions. It also pursues global expansion through acquisitions and partnerships, enhancing its technological capabilities and market reach.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of fertilizer additives, specialty fertilizers, biological products, and digital agriculture services. The company also earns income from licensing intellectual property and providing integrated technical solutions under the PSC (Product, Solution, Contractor) service model. Export sales and domestic sales to large fertilizer manufacturers and agricultural enterprises constitute significant revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hubei Forbon Technology is positioned as a leading global player in fertilizer additives and specialty fertilizers, competing with international brands such as YARA, ICL, EuroChem, and OCP. It holds a strong market position due to its comprehensive product portfolio, advanced R&D capabilities, and global supply chain integration. The company is recognized as a top-tier enterprise in the fertilizer additive industry with significant competitive advantages in technology and service innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.235 billion, representing a 17.79% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 93.59 million, up 30.81%. The company maintains a solid asset base of about RMB 1.92 billion with a stable equity position. It has demonstrated consistent growth in both domestic and international markets, with significant expansion in biological products and digital agriculture segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its integrated 'biological technology + digital technology' dual-drive approach, offering customized, green, efficient, and nutrient-enriched fertilizer additives and modern agricultural solutions. Its PSC comprehensive service model fosters close collaboration with customers, providing tailored formulations and technical support that enhance fertilizer quality and production efficiency. The company’s advanced R&D platforms, global supply chain, and innovative digital agriculture services deliver unique value by enabling sustainable, precise, and cost-effective agricultural production.
